name: Beachside Auckland 2024

venue.name: Bucklands and Eastern Beaches Memorial Hall
venue.address: 48 The Parade, Bucklands Beach, Auckland 2012, New Zealand

information: Beachside Auckland 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering.
